arguments.sql_query:
SELECT concept_id, concept_name, vocabulary_id, domain_id
FROM omop.concept
WHERE (vocabulary_id = 'ICD10CM' OR vocabulary_id = 'SNOMED' OR vocabulary_id = 'ICD9CM')
  AND lower(concept_code) LIKE ANY (ARRAY['%I2%', '%I4%', '%I5%', '%I7%', '%I8%', '%41%', '%42%', '%43%', '%44%', '%45%', '%46%', '%47%', '%041%', '%042%', '%41%x%', '%42x%', '%43x%', '%44x%,%45x', '%46x%', '%47x%', '%hypertens%'])
  AND standard_concept IS NOT NULL
  AND concept_class_id IN ('Clinical Finding', 'Disorder', 'Syndrome', 'Procedure', 'Condition')
  AND invalid_reason IS NULL
ORDER BY vocabulary_id, concept_code
LIMIT 80;

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT TOP 200 concept_id, concept_name, vocabulary_id, concept_code, domain_id
FROM omop.concept
WHERE standard_concept = 'S' AND invalid_reason IS NULL
AND (vocabulary_id = 'ICD10CM' OR vocabulary_id = 'SNOMED')
AND (concept_class_id IN ('Clinical Finding', 'Disorder', 'Syndrome') OR vocabulary_id = 'SNOMED')
AND (lower(concept_code) LIKE '%I0%' OR lower(concept_code) LIKE '%I4%' OR lower(concept_code) LIKE '%I5%' OR lower(concept_code) LIKE '%I7%' OR lower(concept_code) LIKE '%J95%' OR concept_name LIKE '%Coronary%' OR concept_name LIKE '%Cardiomyopathy%' OR concept_name LIKE '%Heart Failure%')
ORDER BY vocabulary_id, concept_code;

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT 
    p.gender_source_value AS gender,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cv_counts.distinct_conditions >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multimorbidity_count,
    COUNT(*) AS total_patients,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN cv_counts.distinct_conditions >= 2 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL(6,4)) AS multimorbidity_rate_pct
FROM omop.person p
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT 
        co.person_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT co.condition_concept_id) AS distinct_conditions
    FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
    INNER JOIN omop.concept c ON co.condition_concept_id = c.concept_id
    WHERE c.standard_concept = 'S'
      AND c.invalid_reason IS NULL
      AND (
          LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%coronary%' OR
          LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%myocardial infarction%' OR
          LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%heart failure%' OR
          LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%cardiomyopathy%' OR
          LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%arrhythmia%' OR
          LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%angina%' OR
          LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%atrial fibrillation%' OR
          LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%ventricular%' OR
          LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%aortic aneurysm%' OR
          LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%peripheral arterial disease%' OR
          LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%heart valve%' OR
          LOWER(c.concept_code) LIKE 'I0%' OR
          LOWER(c.concept_code) LIKE 'I25%' OR
          LOWER(c.concept_code) LIKE 'I48%' OR
          LOWER(c.concept_code) LIKE 'I50%' OR
          LOWER(c.concept_code) LIKE 'I70%'
      )
    GROUP BY co.person_id
) cv_counts ON p.person_id = cv_counts.person_id
GROUP BY p.gender_source_value
ORDER BY gender;
